parts:
Hi Ben,

Maybe this is close enough?

library(stringr)
ggplot(data=subset(foo, Domain=="Domain2"), aes(x=factor(Type),
y=Score, fill=Provider)) +
geom_bar(width=.7, stat="identity", position=position_dodge()) +
scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width=40)) +
coord_flip() +
theme(legend.position="bottom")

Best,
Ista
